needed.evidence: No purpose-built footway; pedestrians must walk in the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide safe pedestrian space.

needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m wide, not usable as a proper footway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a proper, continuous sidewalk at least 1m wide on the right side to ensure safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections on the informal path that pose trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path on the right side to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: Marked crossing is poorly visible and obstructed by the wet road conditions.
needed.suggestion: Install raised platforms or reflective markings at the crossing to enhance visibility and ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing.
needed.suggestion: Add kerb ramps at both ends of the crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian access and mobility.
